facts.text: The piece was first performed at the Burgtheater in Vienna on 5 October 1762, in the presence of Empress Maria Theresa.

facts.text: Though originally set to an Italian libretto, Orfeo ed Euridice owes much to the genre of French opera, particularly in its use of accompanied recitative and a general absence of vocal virtuosity.
